'''Megan's''' was an establishment on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. The name was printed in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] on a [[Color/Legends|yellow]] and green sign.
